product_metadata.title: Bare Decor Erika Corner Shower Spa Mat in Solid Teak Wood and Oiled Finish, X-Large, 30" x 30"
features: The high oil content works as a natural moisture barrier as well as giving it a rich warm coloring.
Perfect for a corner space with soft rounded edges
description: Escape from the ordinary with this X-large Erika teak corner shower mat. It will bring the feel of a tranquil spa right into your home. Made of responsibly harvested solid teak wood (tectona grandis), it has a high degree of natural durability. The high oil content works as a natural moisture barrier as well as giving it a rich warm coloring. This mat is made of premium solid teak wood and comes in an oiled finish. Perfect for a corner space outside your sauna, pool, spa, shower, bathroom, deck, boat or RV and will keep your feet warm while providing a clean slip resistant surface. Measures 30" x 30" with one softly rounded corner. The slats are 1.25" wide and it is 1.5" off the floor.
